description: Enforces reading and adhering to AGENTS.md before executing any action or tool call

hooks.prompt: Before taking any action on the user prompt ($USER_PROMPT), read and strictly follow all rules and guidelines in c:\Programmer\diet-maker\AGENTS.md, including Atomic Design hierarchy, Shadcn UI preservation, and file organization rules (/tests and /refs).

Before executing ANY action or tool ($TOOL_NAME with input $TOOL_INPUT), read and verify full compliance with c:\Programmer\diet-maker\AGENTS.md: 1. Atomic Design 5-level hierarchy (atoms, molecules, organisms, templates, pages). 2. Shadcn UI base component preservation & child component creation. 3. File placement rules (/tests for tests, /refs for references). If the planned tool use violates any AGENTS.md directive, return systemMessage with mandatory corrections or block non-compliant operations.
